p.espaces.b_kind_customs: Tax, freight forwarder, import-export (bidding or seeking)
p.espaces.rg_d: Taxes, product standards, start-up business, investment platforms: official resources of each country.
p.espaces.rg_sub: Rules change often: ONE WORLD does not copy them, it opens the latest official source, then you read it in your language.
p.espaces.rg_g1: Global Trade Helpdesk (ITC, UNCTAD, WTO): for products and countries, taxes, fees, regulations and procedures on one page
p.espaces.rg_g2: Market Access Map (MAM): customs duties and rules of origin
p.espaces.rg_g3: ePing (WTO): standards, labels and health regulations set by countries for products
p.espaces.rg_e1: Access2Markets: Trade with and from the EU, step by step
p.espaces.rg_e2: TARIC: tax and duty codes when entering the EU
p.espaces.rg_b1: Business Ready (World Bank): starting a business, tax, international trade, country by country
p.espaces.rg_i1: I-SCAN (IOSCO): check that the platform has not been signed by the regulator before trusting it with money
p.espaces.rg_note: The site is opened in its own language: use your browser's translations, or "Understand the document" for documents. For important decisions, ask a professional in the country.
p.espaces.cu_d: Assignments, documents, Incoterms, free official tools, shippers and carriers.
p.espaces.cu_sub: Guide to buying and selling between countries. 24/24 ONE WORLD does not file tax returns: licensed tax brokers (shipping agents) can do it for you.
p.espaces.cu_t1: Market Access Map (ITC, UN-WTO): responsibilities and rules for almost every country
p.espaces.cu_t2: Access2Markets (EU): taxes, taxes, origin rules, step by step
p.espaces.cu_t3: TARIC: tax code (HS code) and tax on entry into the European Union
p.espaces.cu_d3: Transport documents: bill of lading (sea), air waybill (air), CMR (road)
p.espaces.cu_d4: Certificate of origin (to get tax deductions)
p.espaces.cu_d5: EORI number (business importing or exporting in the EU)
p.espaces.cu_d6: Depending on the product: health or phytosanitary certificate, license, CE standard
p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: Buyer handles everything from seller's factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: the seller delivers the goods approved for export to the buyer's carrier.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: seller loads goods into ship; after that, risk and cost are the buyer's.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: The seller pays the cost of shipping and insurance to the port of destination.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: Seller ships to destination, buyer pays import duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: the seller pays everything, including import duties.
p.espaces.cu_ban: Forbidden or controlled everywhere: weapons, drugs, counterfeit goods, protected species (CITES), some medicines. Lists like this are rejected and can be reported (ad).
p.espaces.cu_src: Source: ICC (Incoterms 2020), ITC, European Commission, douane.gouv.fr. Always check the correct regulations for your product.

p.espaces.mt_d: Western Union, MoneyGram, Wise, Remitly... compare the fees for your country before you send.
p.espaces.mt_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD does not send money itself and gets nothing from this link: you compare here, then you send with the service you choose.
p.espaces.mt_wb: Remittance Prices Worldwide (World Bank): real cost of sending money, country by country, service by service
p.espaces.mt_p_wu: Cash transfers in many countries, bank transfers, mobile wallets.
p.espaces.mt_p_mg: Cash transfers, bank transfers, mobile wallets.
p.espaces.mt_p_wise: Bank transfer at market exchange rate, charges shown before you send
p.espaces.mt_p_rem: Bank transfers, mobile wallets, cash withdrawals.
p.espaces.mt_p_wr: Mobile wallets, bank transfers, cash withdrawals.
p.espaces.mt_p_tt: Send to mobile wallet or bank account
p.espaces.mt_k1: See the amount received: fee + exchange rate. Rates worse than the market rate are hidden costs.
p.espaces.mt_k2: Choose how people receive it: cash, bank account or mobile wallet (M-Pesa, Orange Money, MTN…).
p.espaces.mt_k3: ID documents are often required, either for sending or collecting.
p.espaces.mt_k4: Never send money to someone you just met online, or to "open" gifts, packages, loans or visas: it's almost always a scam.
p.espaces.mt_note: Services and prices change: always check their website when you send.
p.espaces.ds_d: Sell without stock: find suppliers, set the right price, follow the law.
p.espaces.ds_sub: Dropshipping means selling products that the supplier sends directly to your customers. Easy to start, but you are still responsible for the sales.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose products that are authorized in your customer's country: no counterfeit goods, no controlled products without authorization.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find a supplier ("Wholesale / supplier" list here or wholesale platform) and order samples before you sell.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Get the real price: product, shipping, taxes, VAT customer country, payment and returns.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Tell your customers the actual delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: List your activities: business status, VAT and taxes according to your country (see trade regulations).
p.espaces.ds_s6: Respecting the rights of the customer: clear prices including taxes, right of return, guarantee, data protection.
p.espaces.ds_w1: The vendor wants full payment with unsecured bank transfer or in cryptocurrency.
p.espaces.ds_w2: A paid course that promises to make you rich quickly.
p.espaces.ds_w3: Stolen photos and fake reviews: prohibited and punished.
p.espaces.ds_w4: In the European Union, a package from outside the EU pays VAT from the first euro.
p.espaces.ds_plat: Wholesale platform (private, not connected to 24/24 ONE WORLD)

p.papier.title: ind_Latn
Understand the document
p.papier.sub: Take a picture of a letter, prescription, form or sign: read it in your language.
p.papier.private: The photo will remain on your phone. Only the read text is sent to the free translation service.
p.papier.first: First time for this language: phone downloaded its reading data (a few MB).
p.papier.none: No text found. Take another photo, smooth and with more light.
p.papier.e_lib: Read cannot be started: first time requires Internet. Try again when connected.
p.papier.e_tr: Translation could not be performed (connection or daily limit). Try again.
p.papier.warn: Machine translation: for important documents (court, health, money, residence permits), make sure they are checked by someone you trust or an association. Handwriting is often misread.
p.papier.help: Ask for help in Peer Help
